units.source_text: 薰君身上具有这种令人惊诧的香气，匂兵部卿亲王对此事异常妒羡，比其他任何事情更甚。

en.t: Lord Kaoru possessed this astonishing fragrance about him, and Prince Niou, the Prince of the Ministry of War, envied and resented it more than anything else.

units.source_text: 他只得特备种种香料，把衣服薰透。

en.t: He therefore had to prepare all sorts of special perfumes and steep his robes thoroughly in their scent.

units.source_text: 朝朝暮暮，专以配合香料为事。

en.t: Morning and evening, he devoted himself entirely to blending perfumes.

units.source_text: 到庭院里去看花时，春天只管躲在梅花园里，希望染得梅香。

en.t: When he went into the garden to look at the flowers, in spring he stayed hidden away in the plum grove, hoping to take on the scent of plum blossoms.

units.source_text: 到了秋天，世人所喜爱的女郎花和小牡鹿所视为妻子的带露的萩花，

en.t: When autumn came, the maiden flowers loved by everyone, and the dew-laden bush clover that young stags regard as their mates,

units.source_text: 只为无香气，全不惹他注目。

en.t: failed to catch his eye at all, simply because they had no fragrance.

units.source_text: 而对于那忘老的菊花、日渐枯萎的兰草、毫不足观的地榆，

en.t: But as for the chrysanthemums said to make one forget age, the orchids withering day by day, and the burnet that was hardly worth looking at,

units.source_text: 只为有香气，即使到了霜打风摧、枯折不全的时候，

en.t: because they had fragrance, even when frost had struck them, wind had battered them, and they were withered, broken, and ruined,
he still refused to cast them aside.

units.source_text: 如此特意用心，专以爱香为务。

en.t: In this way he took special pains and made the love of fragrance his sole pursuit.

units.source_text: 世人便议论他：“这位匂兵部卿亲王的爱香癖有些过分，未免太风流了。”

en.t: People therefore said of him, "This Prince Niou of the Ministry of War carries his passion for fragrance rather too far; he is almost excessively elegant."

units.source_text: 昔年源氏在世之时，对于无论何事，从不偏爱一端而异常地热衷。

en.t: In former days, when Genji was alive, he never favored any one thing exclusively or became strangely absorbed in it, whatever it might be.
